title: Apartment Fire Door Critical Quality Check
status: Example only – not agreed. Built to show James how a module works.

questions.q: Is the door set the approved type and rating, with the certification label intact on the leaf and frame?
questions.source: Example – confirm against ITP / tech sub

questions.q: Are frame-to-wall gaps within the certified range and filled with the specified intumescent sealant?
questions.source: Example – confirm against ITP / tech sub

questions.source: Example – confirm against ITP / tech sub

questions.q: Are intumescent and smoke seals continuous, undamaged and not painted over?
questions.source: Example – confirm against ITP / tech sub

questions.q: Is all ironmongery to schedule, with no unapproved routing or fixings through intumescent?

questions.q: Does the self-closer close and latch the door from 90° and from 10°?
questions.source: Example – confirm against ITP / tech sub

questions.q: Is the fire door sign fitted and the door free of damage or site alterations?
